name: Rubin Observatory First Look
notes: A technology milestone, not a physics result. Source is the observatory's own history page (not a press release).

summary.plain: On 23 June 2025 the Rubin Observatory released its first public images and video, shown at a press conference in Washington, D.C. and more than 300 watch parties worldwide, the first public view of what its camera and telescope can do.
summary.technical: Rubin Observatory First Look, 23 June 2025: first public images and video from the Simonyi Survey Telescope and LSST Camera, released in a globally coordinated event. The LSST began on 29 June 2026.

title: First Look at Rubin imagery
why_it_matters: The Rubin history page records the First Look release as the first public demonstration of Rubin imagery, followed in October 2025 by the official transition from construction to operations and in June 2026 by the start of the 10-year LSST.
